narrative: Cable management repair in B04. Wire runs had dropped into the mow path in ten places, all resecured and clipped clear. On inspection most of the failures are at the clip fixing rather than the cable having pulled through, which points at the clip type rather than the installation. Recommend the heavier clip we went to on the north blocks is used when this row is next reworked, this is the second rework on this block inside a year.
